item.tib: theg chen lta ba'i gshen glu gsungs pa'i dbu phyogs
item.note: this text contains three different works. pp. 431-440 contain a song of mi-lus bsam-legs (compare bsam legs kyi gshen glu de'u gsum in text no. 32.10). pp. 441-442 contain still another short song by mi-lus bsam-legs. pp. 443-444 contain a song by dmu-gshen nyi-ma rgyal-mtshan. on mi-lus bsam-legs, see martin, mandala cosmogony. compare katen, p. 115 (no. 012-23).
